positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Co-founded direct-to-consumer e-commerce startup whose mission is to provide functional fashion for women.
- Designed company’s launch product: jeans with unique functional pockets.
- Worked with various domestic and international suppliers to design and develop and manufacture multiple jean lines.
- Built e-commerce experience, custom exchange, and referral system.
- Designed brand identity including logo, custom printed packages, and marketing collateral.
- Developed a marketing, social media, and launch strategy in consultation with communications specialists.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Instructed 250+ students in data structures and algorithms (using Java and Python) through TA hours, section, clinic, and grading.
- Mentored students in course selections, career path, and internship applications.

positions.title: Research Intern on Threat Team
positions.description:
- Revamped the internal log parser to be accessible on a remote device in Python and Javascript, with the server storing parsed logs in MySQL database using SQLAlchemy.
- Enhanced additional functionality to the filtering of application logs.
- Configured an SMTP honeypot to collect and record ~1 million spam/day.
- Assembled a web server honeypot with a sandbox.
- Migrated an Alexa skill to query the most recent version of SentinelOne's API and hardened the security on requests made to the skill's authentication server.

positions.description: - Researched and tested the potential of dynamic fingerprinting – a next-generation user tracking technology with potentially interesting privacy consequences – specifically related to identifying configuration changes made to a user’s hardware or software.
